name: io.github.r69shabh/pg-bloat-detective
title: PG Bloat Detective
description: Read-only Postgres bloat diagnosis: verdicts (blocked-by/vacuum-starved/needs-rewrite/index-bloated), named blockers with PID+query, timelines, before/after proof. No writes to prod.

environmentVariables.name: BLOAT_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Postgres DSN (read-only enforced: 5s statement timeout, read-only tx)

environmentVariables.name: BLOAT_DB
environmentVariables.description: SQLite timeline file written by bloatdetective collect
